Welcome to Classic CSS

The stylesheet that lets you create websites that look like an old Windows 2000 application.

Include classic.css and use plain HTML: buttons, inputs, selects, checkboxes, fieldsets and progress bars are styled out of the box. Windows, menus, toolbars, tabs, tree views, list views and even a desktop with taskbar are a few classes away.

classic.js is optional. It adds proper menu handling, tab switching, list selection and draggable windows to elements marked with data-* attributes.

Pick a component from the tree on the left.
